leads.sub_pill: 2 struck leaving the strait · no casualties
leads.title: Two tankers hit leaving Hormuz as Iran tightens its grip on shipping
leads.body: One struck on the stern, one in the engine room; traffic down ~65%. IRGC claims tankers hit mines, unverified. (UKMTO, Al Jazeera, Reuters)

leads.sub_pill: Approval session set for 0600 GMT Sunday
leads.title: COP31 nears a deal as a new text is tabled after overtime talks
leads.body: Turkish and Australian hosts address fossil-fuel and adaptation-finance concerns; plenary approval pending. (Reuters)

leads.title: Russian military cargo ship ablaze in the Baltic after drone strike
leads.body: Sparta II burned west of Gogland and drifted into Finnish waters; all 16 crew evacuated safely. (Reuters, Finnish MoD)

cards.title: Bahrain says Iranian strike set an industrial site ablaze
cards.sub: No injuries reported; the IRGC says it hit US bases. (Bahrain govt, Reuters)

cards.title: Iran begins rationing electricity from Sunday
cards.sub: Cuts of up to two hours a day as gas output lags. (RFE/RL)

cards.title: Rutte in Warsaw: all of NATO stands with Poland
cards.sub: Visit follows Friday's airspace incursion; Council meets Mon. (Reuters)

cards.title: Ukrainian drones hit Russia's Leningrad region
cards.sub: Regional air defences down dozens overnight. (RTÉ, Reuters)

cards.title: Drone strike on a Gaza food-aid van kills three
cards.sub: IDF says it targeted militants; 1,671 killed since truce. (Al Jazeera, AP)

cards.title: Mexico captures cartel boss "El Chapo Isidro"
cards.sub: FBI top-10 fugitive seized in Guasave raid; 11 killed in clashes. (AP)

cards.title: Trump plays down reported hack of FBI crime database
cards.sub: FBI probes cyber intrusion at NCIC network. (AP, CNN)

cards.title: Landmine kills 22 on a road to El-Obeid
cards.sub: Passenger tuk-tuk hit near Umm Arda; civilians dead. (Darfur24)

cards.title: Belgian national strike to ground flights on Monday
cards.sub: No regular air traffic 07:00–21:00 over budget cuts. (Skeyes, AFP)

cards.title: Verstappen on pole as Vegas races under the lights
cards.sub: Antonelli dropped 5 places; race ~04:00 UTC Sunday. (F1)
